header: Appendix CWhich model wrote the text?

images.caption: Table 20:Detectors name the lab behind nearly every big-three text, but few texts from the other eight labs.Share of each writer’s 75 texts for which each detector names the right lab (%). The Overall row and each lab’s row pool the writers beneath them, and bold numbers mark the best detector in those rows. The other eight labs run from best to worst identified, and writers run newest first. Newer models from those labs are rarely traced to their own lab: Claude Opus 5.5 names Moonshot for 51% of Kimi K2.5 texts and for none of Kimi K3’s.
